q1_issues.issue: The explicit concessive 'although' yields no connective atom at all; an explicit non-temporal connective must emit its UpperCamelCase surface head relating the two reified clauses.

The partitive 'one of her former schoolmates' is collapsed to a single witness — no definite superset group, no `SubsetOf`, no `(Cardinality S 1)` — so the presupposed set and the 'one of' count are lost.

'former' is split off as a standalone predicated property `(Member sk_schoolmate_1 former)`, asserting that the person is former; the adjective fails the predication test and must not be exposed that way.
'Police' is a bare plural subject of an episodic clause, which mints a group witness `(GroupOf sk_police_1 police)`; `Member` types it as one individual of kind police instead.
The although-clause plausibly falls inside what the police said; if so the two denial bundles are asserted at top level in breach of the non-factive bar on `say`.
